children: John B. Spath, an Officer serving as Executive Vice President and Head of Operations, reported sales of common stock on 2026-08-27 with a weighted average selling price of $16.90 per share across multiple transactions at prices ranging from $16.79 to $16.96, producing total proceeds of $1,520,999; following the reported transaction, Spath directly owns 178,788 shares of common stock.

Gregory Babcock, an Officer serving as Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, reported sales of common stock on 2026-08-27 at a weighted average price of $16.74 per share across multiple transactions at prices ranging from $16.73 to $16.81, producing total proceeds of $1,026,279; following the transaction, Babcock directly owns 84,509 shares of common stock.
